summary: United Natural Foods filed an 8-K reporting fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 results and disclosing that on September 3, 2026 the board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $200 million, terminating the September 2022 program. Q4 net sales fell 0.7% to $7.6 billion and full-year sales declined 2.0% to $31.2 billion, with Q4 net income of $35 million. Buybacks may occur via open market, privately negotiated transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans; no fixed expiration, no purchase obligation, suspendable at any time. Watch pace versus free cash flow and leverage.
